description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

General Dynamics Mission Systems develops high-technology solutions that support defense, intelligence, scientific, and public-safety missions. The Entry Level Software Engineer will assist project leaders with researching, designing, developing, testing, coding, and documenting software, tools, applications, systems, and embedded products.
Software engineer developing, testing, and documenting applications, systems, and embedded products

Responsibilities:
• Working successfully within a team, the Software Engineer will assist project leaders in the research, design, development and testing of software and tools, to include development of new work products or enhancing existing applications, systems or embedded products
• This may include coding, testing and documenting software solutions to advance our technology solutions

Requirements:
• Requires a Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, or a related Science, Engineering or Mathematics field
• Candidates must be able to obtain a TS clearance within a reasonable amount of time from date of hire
• Applicants selected ... must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information
• U.S. citizenship is required
• A Bachelor's degree in software engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience is required
• Clear understanding of software engineering concepts, principles, and theories
• Clear understanding of the software development process
• Cloud services, particularly AWS and Kubernetes, rather than traditional server-focused experience
• Linux
• MATLAB
• Digital Signal Processing (DSP) — development experience is not required, but candidates should have a solid understanding of DSP concepts
• Ability to grasp and apply new information quickly and handle increasing responsibilities with growing complexity
• Team player who thrives in collaborative environments and revels in team success
• Commitment to ongoing professional development

Preferred:
• Agile experience preferred
• Department of Defense Top Secret clearance is preferred at time of hire
• Agile experience preferred
• Raspberry Pi experience preferred, especially in hardware-device applications
• Active Top Secret clearance strongly preferred
